native_item: Compile MDL text to binary model
native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:43-79 (DoCompile loads .mdl namespace and writes a binary model file)
native_body: The MDL compiler turns a textual .mdl model definition into a binary model the engine loads.
native_rule: The MDL compiler turns textual .mdl into a binary model.
port_cite_or_reason: tools/mdl-to-glb/MdlWriter.cs (writes native .mdl binary); import path GlbImporter->MdlWriter (Program.cs:19-21)
notes: Port writes native .mdl binary on glTF import, covering the compile step.

native_body: The compiler can optimize a model's thing-geometry for size, saving an optimized .mdl.
native_rule: The compiler can optimize thing-geometry for size.
port_cite_or_reason: Port export/import normalizes meshes but exposes no explicit optimize pass equivalent to OptimizeThingGeo.

native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:166-207 (DoConvert loads a bitmap and writes it as an engine texture namespace)
native_body: The tool converts a source bitmap into the engine's texture format for embedding in a model.
native_rule: The tool converts a source bitmap to the engine texture format.
port_cite_or_reason: tools/mdl-to-glb/PngCodec.cs (PNG encode/decode for the authoring pipeline, P824) + TestTextureGenerator.cs; gentexture command (Program.cs:62)
notes: FIXED cite: the real texture decoder is PngCodec.cs (MdlTextureDecoder.cs does not exist).

native_body: The compiler can compress a sprite-sheet model animation sequence (given x/y frame grid) into the engine's compact form.
native_rule: The compiler compresses animation sequences into a compact form.
notes: No native-format animation compression exists in the port model toolchain.

native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:98-108 (DoGenHeader writes a C++ type header)
native_body: The tool can emit a generated C++ type header from a model namespace.
native_rule: The tool emits a generated C++ type header.
port_cite_or_reason: Compile-time C++ type-header generation is native build plumbing with no runtime/modding relevance.

native_body: The tool prints a model's geometric summary for inspection.
native_rule: The tool prints a model's geometric summary.

native_cite: mdlc ships .cvh alongside .mdl; native cvh consumed by the engine
native_body: The toolchain must read and write a model's convex-collision hull (.cvh) data.
port_cite_or_reason: tools/mdl-to-glb/CvhWriter.cs; ConvexHull.cs; gentesthull command (Program.cs:63); import writes .cvh, export reads it (Program.cs:89-91)

native_cite: mdlc is the sole native model pipeline; port extends it with a modding bridge
native_body: Models can round-trip out to a standard external format and back without losing hardpoints/mounts, lights, LODs or collision hulls.
native_rule: Models round-trip to an external format and back losslessly.
port_cite_or_reason: tools/mdl-to-glb/Program.cs:19-21 (export / import / verifyimport); GlbReader.cs; GlbImporter.cs; GlbWriter.cs; NativeModelAdapter.cs; SidecarDocument.cs (P823)
notes: Port addition (Core2Text): the glTF bridge is the modding-dev-tool port of the native mdl pipeline.

native_body: There is an interactive editor for viewing and editing MDL models.
native_rule: Interactive editor for viewing/editing MDL models.
port_cite_or_reason: Port offers no graphical editor; external glTF editors plus the import round-trip (Program.cs:19-21) substitute for it.

native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:285-310 (PromptUserForVideoSettings, CD3DDevice9 CreateDevice, VRAM/VBIB/CVertexGenerator Init, EffectApp::Initialize)
native_body: The native compiler spins up a Direct3D9 device and effect-app context before processing models, and prompts for video settings.
native_rule: The native tool runs inside a D3D9 graphics context with video-setup prompt.
port_cite_or_reason: Win32/Direct3D9-era host scaffolding; the port model toolchain is a headless CLI with no graphics-context dependency.

native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:276-284 (UpdatingConfiguration over config_mdlc.json + RegistryConfigurationStore HKCU MDLC3DSettings)
native_body: The compiler reads its settings and art path from a JSON config file and the Windows registry.
native_rule: The tool reads settings/art-path from config + registry.
port_cite_or_reason: Windows registry configuration store is era/plumbing; the port takes paths as CLI arguments.
